name: Marian
source:
The librarian. She aspires to become a great poet but her dwindling self-confidence more than often gets in the way. Her route in the first game focuses on Steve and Marian working together to help the librarian overcome her weakness.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Flower_Shop]Wikipedia[/url]]
